title: Color / Full palette — CMYK specifications

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: CMYK

slide_intent: Specify the ink mixture for each named color, because visual resemblance on a screen does not define a repeatable print build.
strategic_value: A common process-color table can reduce inconsistent ad hoc conversions in IBM printed communication.
demonstration: The CMYK tab shows cyan, magenta, yellow and black values inside the dark-to-light hue and gray swatches.
practical_value: Use the supplied four-channel build when preparing process-color artwork for the selected palette entry.

content_islands.name: Process-color selector
content_islands.spec: Place the selected CMYK tab above the swatch table.

content_islands.name: Hue builds
content_islands.spec: Show seven hue families with c/m/y/k values beside each named grade.

content_islands.name: Gray builds
content_islands.spec: Close with the three neutral families, including four-channel Black and zero-ink White.

reference_purposes.Expression: The swatch rows preserve IBM’s chromatic and neutral family structure.
reference_purposes.Application: The tab gives explicit CMYK builds; Blue 60 is c 80 m 60 y 0 k 0 and White is c 0 m 0 y 0 k 0.
